cards.title: 多轮工具调用LLM智能体实现自适应因子挖掘
cards.titleEn: Multi-Turn Tool-Using LLM Agents Enable Adaptive Alpha Mining
cards.summary: 论文提出 AlphaPilot，一个通过强化学习训练多轮工具调用 LLM 智能体的框架，用于自适应公式化因子挖掘。作者报告在 CSI300 与 CSI500 的样本外滚动回测三次独立运行中，平均总收益分别为 42.93% 和 54.19%，平均夏普比率分别为 2.46 和 2.86，并在两个股票池上取得所评估方法中最高的平均总收益、夏普与 RankIC。以上数值为作者在特定回测设置下的报告结果。
cards.descriptionEn: Existing formulaic alpha mining methods typically exploit only a subset of signals among market text, historical data, and quantitative evaluation. AlphaPilot integrates market descriptions, LLM financial knowledge, real-data evaluator feedback, and a retained factor pool within a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework, and performs day-by-day search at inference to adapt to shifting market regimes, thereby jointly leveraging multiple signal types for alpha mining.
cards.description: 现有公式化因子挖掘方法通常只利用市场文本、历史数据或量化评估中的部分信号，AlphaPilot 将市场描述、大语言模型的金融知识、真实数据评估反馈与保留因子池整合进一个多轮强化学习框架中，并支持推理时逐日搜索以适应市场状态变化，从而在因子挖掘中同时利用多类信号。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This approach integrates unstructured market descriptions, LLM financial knowledge, real data, and evaluator feedback into a single mining process, and lets the agent dynamically update the factor pool at inference time, offering a referenceable framework for jointly leveraging multiple signal types in alpha mining.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法将非结构化市场描述、LLM 金融知识、真实数据与评估反馈整合到同一挖掘流程，并让智能体在推理时动态更新因子池，为因子挖掘如何联合利用多类信号提供了一种可参考的框架。
keyPoints: 智能体在多轮交互中依据市场描述提出因子表达式，查询真实数据评估器反馈，并跨轮更新保留因子池。
推理阶段采用逐日搜索与因子池更新，以适应市场状态变化。
在 CSI300 与 CSI500 的样本外滚动回测三次独立运行中，报告平均总收益为 42.93% 与 54.19%，平均夏普为 2.46 与 2.86。
cards.limitationsEn: The performance evidence comes from out-of-sample rolling backtests on CSI300 and CSI500 across three independent runs, which are reported results under specific markets, backtest settings, and a limited number of repetitions. No validation across other markets, asset classes, or longer sample periods is provided, and the effects of transaction costs, capacity, slippage, or implementation details are not specified. The reported high returns and Sharpe ratios should not be understood as guarantees of future performance and do not constitute investment advice.
cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces AlphaPilot, a reinforcement learning framework that trains multi-turn tool-using LLM agents for adaptive formulaic alpha mining. The authors report that across three independent out-of-sample rolling backtests on CSI300 and CSI500, mean total returns were 42.93% and 54.19%, with mean Sharpe ratios of 2.46 and 2.86, and that it attained the highest mean total return, Sharpe, and RankIC among the evaluated methods on both universes. These figures are results reported by the authors under specific backtest settings.
keyPointsEn: Across multiple turns, the agent proposes factor expressions conditioned on market descriptions, queries real-data evaluator feedback, and updates a retained factor pool.
At inference time, it performs day-by-day search and pool updates to adapt to shifting market regimes.
Across three independent out-of-sample rolling backtests on CSI300 and CSI500, reported mean total returns were 42.93% and 54.19%, with mean Sharpe ratios of 2.46 and 2.86.
cards.originalTitle: AlphaPilot: Multi-Turn Tool-Using LLM Agents for Adaptive Alpha Mining with Reinforcement Learning
cards.limitations: 性能证据来自 CSI300 与 CSI500 的样本外滚动回测，共三次独立运行，属于特定市场、特定回测设置与有限重复次数下的报告结果，未给出跨市场、跨资产类别或更长样本期的验证，也未说明交易成本、容量、滑点或实现细节对结果的影响；所报告的高收益与夏普不应被理解为对未来表现的保证，也不构成投资建议。

cards.title: 代码交互式K线推理：Fin-Thinker让证据可验证
cards.titleEn: Code-Interactive Candlestick Reasoning: Fin-Thinker Makes Evidence Verifiable
cards.summary: 作者提出代码交互式金融K线推理任务，并给出Fin-Thinker：基于Qwen3.5-9B，通过生成并执行代码获得观测、完成计算，再据此推进推理。为训练该能力，作者构建FinKLine-32K共32184条经replay校验的代码-观测轨迹，并采用三阶段训练：视觉-代码基础微调、金融过程监督、执行反馈强化学习。在FinKLineBench上报告严格准确率相对最佳直答基线提升13.1个百分点，相对其基座模型加沙箱提升33.2个百分点；但所有数字均来自作者自建基准与自报实验，尚需独立复现。
cards.descriptionEn: Existing financial candlestick QA often measures answer accuracy alone, without checking whether predictions are supported by chart evidence. This work introduces code-interactive financial candlestick reasoning: the model generates and executes code to obtain observations and perform computations, then uses returned results to guide subsequent reasoning. It also builds 32K replay-verified trajectories and a 1,200-question benchmark that separately assesses answer correctness
cards.description: 现有金融K线问答仅看答案准确率，无法判断预测是否有图表证据支撑。该工作提出代码交互式K线推理任务，让模型生成并执行代码获取观测与数值计算，再用返回结果引导后续推理。同时构建32K replay校验轨迹与1200题基准，分别评估答案正确性、代码执行与证据落地，为图表推理提供可核验路径。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If financial chart QA only scores final answers, it can reward guessing or memorization rather than genuine use of chart evidence. This work uses code execution as a channel for evidence acquisition and computation and evaluates evidence grounding separately, helping move candlestick understanding from black-box answers toward inspectable reasoning processes, which is more relevant for high-stakes financial analysis.
cards.whyItMatters: 金融图表问答若只看答案，容易奖励猜测或记忆而非真正的图表证据使用。该工作把代码执行作为证据获取和计算通道，并单独评估证据落地，有助于把K线理解从黑箱答案推向可检查的推理过程，对高风险金融分析场景更具参考价值。
keyPoints: 任务设定要求模型先在K线图中定位视觉元素，再跨交易日与面板对齐，并结合数值和金融推理给出答案。
Fin-Thinker用代码获取观测和计算，训练数据FinKLine-32K包含成功解与含错误恢复的轨迹，强调过程可验证。
FinKLineBench含1200题、138类金融任务，分开评估答案正确、代码执行与证据落地；消融显示过程监督和执行反馈强化学习带来连续提升。
cards.limitationsEn: The reported improvements and conclusions are based on the authors' self-built FinKLineBench and self-reported experiments, with no independent third-party replication or out-of-sample validation across markets and time periods shown. The benchmark covers 138 financial task types, but data sources, market scope, time ranges, and annotation quality control details are not fully described in the abstract, so the evidence boundary is limited to this benchmark. Strict accuracy and grounded accuracy depend on exact answers and GPT-5.6 judging, respectively, and the latter may introduce evaluator bias. The model is based on Qwen3.5-9B and requires sandboxed code execution; deployment cost, execution safety, and suitability for low-latency scenarios are not discussed. These results do not constitute investment advice or proof of trading effectiveness.
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a code-interactive financial candlestick reasoning task and present Fin-Thinker, based on Qwen3.5-9B, which generates and executes code to obtain observations and perform calculations before continuing reasoning. To train this capability, they construct FinKLine-32K with 32,184 replay-verified code-observation trajectories and use three-stage training: foundational visual-code fine-tuning, financial process supervision, and execution-feedback reinforcement learning. On FinKLineBench, they report 13.1 percentage-point improvement in strict accuracy over the best direct-answer baseline and 33.2 points over its base model with sandbox access; however, all numbers come from the authors' own benchmark and self-reported experiments and need independent replication.
keyPointsEn: The task requires locating visual elements in candlestick charts, aligning them across trading dates and panels, and combining numerical and financial reasoning to answer.
Fin-Thinker uses code to obtain observations and computations; the FinKLine-32K training data includes successful solutions and error-recovery trajectories, emphasizing verifiable processes.

FinKLineBench contains 1,200 questions across 138 financial task types and separately evaluates answer correctness, code execution, and evidence grounding; ablations show successive gains from process supervision and execution-feedback reinforcement learning.
cards.originalTitle: Code-Interactive Visual Reasoning for Financial Candlestick Understanding
cards.limitations: 论文中的提升幅度与结论均基于作者自建的FinKLineBench和自报实验，未展示独立第三方复现或跨市场、跨时间外样本验证。评测覆盖138类金融任务，但数据来源、市场范围、时间区间和标注质量控制细节未在摘要中充分说明，证据边界受限于该基准。严格准确率与grounded accuracy分别依赖精确答案和GPT-5.6评判，后者可能引入评判偏差。模型基于Qwen3.5-9B且需要沙箱执行代码，实际部署成本、执行安全与低延迟场景适用性未讨论。该结果不构成投资建议或交易有效性证明。

cards.title: 结构化连续时间SDE改进已实现GARCH的积分方差预测
cards.titleEn: Structured Continuous-Time SDEs Improve Realized GARCH Integrated-Variance Forecasting
cards.summary: 作者提出结构化连续时间随机波动率模型，用于预测未来一日积分方差，核心是将 jointly evolving 的已实现测度状态直接接入潜在方差动态，并以相关布朗运动表示与收益相关的依赖。参数通过基于模拟的预测学习估计，积分方差预测由蒙特卡洛模拟完成。作者报告在17个股指上相对GARCH、GARCH-It^o、Realized GARCH、HAR与HEAVY等基准取得较强的样本外表现，消融显示已实现测度反馈贡献显著，收益联动布朗依赖贡献较小；上述结论均为作者基于其设定与数据集的报告，尚需独立验证。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a structured continuous-time stochastic volatility model that embeds a realized-measure state directly into latent variance dynamics and captures return-linked dependence via correlated Brownian innovations. Across 17 equity indices, it reports stronger out-of-sample performance than several GARCH-family and HAR-type benchmarks under QLIKE, MSE and MAE; ablation indicates realized-measure feedback provides substantial incremental value while return-linked B
cards.description: 该研究提出一种结构化连续时间随机波动率模型，将已实现测度状态直接嵌入潜在方差动态，并用相关布朗运动刻画收益联动依赖。通过在17个股指上的样本外比较，其在QLIKE、MSE与MAE下优于多种GARCH族与HAR类基准，并通过消融指出已实现测度反馈贡献显著、收益联动布朗依赖增益较小，为将测量信息纳入连续时间波动建模提供了可操作路径。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible, the framework offers a way to embed high-frequency realized-measure information directly into continuous-time latent variance dynamics, potentially improving short-horizon integrated-variance forecasts and providing a structured ablation design to compare the relative contributions of measurement-driven information and return-linked dependence.
cards.whyItMatters: 若结果可复现，该框架提供了一条将高频已实现测度信息直接嵌入连续时间潜在方差动态的建模思路，有助于改进短期积分方差预测，并为比较测量驱动信息与收益联动依赖的相对贡献提供结构化消融方案。
keyPoints: 模型在连续时间框架下引入与潜在方差共同演化的已实现测度状态，并将相关布朗创新用于刻画收益联动依赖。
预测目标为未来一日积分方差，估计采用基于模拟的预测学习，预测由蒙特卡洛模拟生成。
在17个股指的样本外比较中，QLIKE、MSE与MAE指标下优于GARCH、GARCH-It^o、Realized GARCH、HAR与HEAVY基准；消融显示已实现测度反馈的增量价值大于收益联动布朗依赖。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from the authors' out-of-sample backtests and ablations on 17 equity indices, without details on sample period, market regimes, transaction costs, parameter stability or model risk. Although benchmarks and metrics are fairly comprehensive, independent replication and generalization across assets and frequencies remain unverified. The findings are the authors' observations under a specific setup and sample, and do not constitute investment advice or definitive causal conclusions.
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a structured continuous-time stochastic volatility model for one-day-ahead integrated-variance forecasting, where a jointly evolving realized-measure state feeds directly into latent variance dynamics and correlated Brownian innovations capture return-linked dependence. Parameters are estimated via simulation-based predictive learning, and forecasts are generated by Monte Carlo simulation. The authors report strong out-of-sample performance against GARCH, GARCH-It^o, Realized GARCH, HAR and HEAVY benchmarks on 17 equity indices, with ablation showing substantial incremental value from realized-measure feedback and more modest gains from return-linked Brownian dependence; these findings are the authors' reports under their specific setup and dataset and require independent verification.
keyPointsEn: The model introduces a realized-measure state that jointly evolves with latent variance in continuous time, and uses correlated Brownian innovations to capture return-linked dependence.
It targets one-day-ahead integrated variance, estimates parameters through simulation-based predictive learning, and generates forecasts via Monte Carlo simulation.

On 17 equity indices, it outperforms GARCH, GARCH-It^o, Realized GARCH, HAR and HEAVY benchmarks under QLIKE, MSE and MAE; ablation indicates realized-measure feedback adds more incremental value than return-linked Brownian dependence.
cards.originalTitle: Structured SDEs for Realized GARCH: Continuous-Time Volatility Modelling and Component-Level Analysis
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自作者在17个股指上的样本外回测与消融实验，未说明数据期间、市场状态、交易成本、参数稳定性与模型风险等；基准选择与指标虽较全面，但独立复现与跨资产、跨频率的泛化能力尚未验证。文中结论为作者基于特定设定与样本的观察，不构成任何投资建议或确定性因果结论。

cards.title: 粗糙鞅最优传输：稀疏数据下非可建模风险因子的有限定价边界框架
cards.titleEn: Rough Martingale Optimal Transport: Finite Pricing Bounds for Non-Modelable Risk Factors under Sparse Data
cards.summary: 经典鞅最优传输在非可建模风险因子上因市场数据稀疏而得到无限审计边界，该文提出以粗糙波动率先验正则化传输计划的粗糙鞅最优传输框架。作者声称该框架可产生有限、显式且渐近紧的外推边界，并在SPY、QQQ期权数据上观察到与粗糙波动率渐近性质一致的拉伸指数尾部衰减。文中报告在SPX/NDX实盘数据验证及30资产扩展下，每10亿美元奇异账簿相较经典方法约有8800万美元资本缓释。上述识别性结论、校准观察与资本缓释数字均为作者陈述，尚待独立复现与监管口径核实。
cards.descriptionEn: Addressing the infinite audit bounds that classical Martingale Optimal Transport yields for non-modelable risk factors with sparse market data, this work proposes a Rough Martingale Optimal Transport framework that regularizes the transport plan with a rough volatility prior to obtain finite and asymptotically tight extrapolation bounds. Its novelty lies in identifiability theorems for rough volatility parameters and local identifiability of multi-asset correlation; its usefu
cards.description: 该研究针对经典鞅最优传输在处理非可建模风险因子时给出无限审计边界的问题，提出以粗糙波动率先验正则化传输计划的粗糙鞅最优传输框架，理论上可在稀疏数据下获得有限且渐近紧的价差边界。其新意在于建立粗糙波动率参数的可辨识性定理并给出多资产相关性可局部识别的条件，实用性体现在为FRTB合规下奇异衍生品定价提供显式误差量化。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the identifiability and tightness claims hold, the framework could provide finite pricing bounds with explicit error quantification for data-sparse non-modelable risk factors under FRTB, replacing the uninformative intervals of classical methods and potentially affecting how capital is measured for exotic derivative books.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该框架的可辨识性与紧性结论成立，将有助于在FRTB监管要求下为数据稀疏的非可建模风险因子提供有限且带显式误差量化的定价边界，替代经典方法给出的无信息区间，并可能影响奇异衍生品账簿的资本计量方式。
keyPoints: 框架用粗糙波动率先验正则化传输计划，使经典MOT的无限审计边界变为有限、显式且渐近紧的外推边界，并建立粗糙波动率参数在稀疏数据下的可辨识性定理，证明50个行权价足以将Hurst指数估计控制在±0.05以内。
多资产情形下证明：当各资产Hurst指数互不相同时，相关性矩阵可由边际期权曲面局部识别。
基于2019—2024年SPY与QQQ期权校准发现，最优鞅测度呈拉伸指数尾部衰减，与粗糙波动率渐近一致，而经典MOT仅给出平凡边界；作者在SPX/NDX实盘数据上验证并以块稀疏优化扩展至30个资产。
cards.limitationsEn: All theoretical and empirical results are author-reported, replication depends on the same data and solver settings, and they have not been independently verified. The ±0.05 and 50-strike identifiability result and local correlation identifiability rest on model assumptions and sparsity settings; conclusions may fail if real markets deviate. The roughly $880M per $1B capital relief and 100-seed cross-validation conservative coverage apply only to specific sample periods and book structures and do not constitute regulatory endorsement or investment advice. The rough volatility prior itself carries model risk: if misspecified, bounds may understate true risk. The 30-asset extension relies on block-sparse optimization whose numerical stability and large-scale extrapolation remain to be tested.
cards.summaryEn: Classical Martingale Optimal Transport produces infinite audit bounds for non-modelable risk factors due to sparse market data, and this paper proposes a Rough Martingale Optimal Transport framework that regularizes the transport plan with a rough volatility prior. The authors claim this yields finite, explicit, and asymptotically tight extrapolation bounds, and on SPY and QQQ options they observe stretched exponential tail decay consistent with rough volatility asymptotics. They report validation on live SPX/NDX data and scaling to 30 assets, with roughly $880M in capital relief per $1B exotic book versus classical methods. These identifiability results, calibration observations, and capital relief figures are author claims awaiting independent replication and regulatory verification.
keyPointsEn: The framework regularizes the transport plan with a rough volatility prior, turning the infinite audit bounds of classical MOT into finite, explicit, and asymptotically tight extrapolation bounds, and establishes an identifiability theorem for rough volatility parameters under sparse data, proving that 50 strikes suffice to estimate the Hurst exponent within ±0.05.
For the multi-asset case, it proves that the correlation matrix is locally identifiable from marginal option surfaces provided the Hurst exponents are distinct.

Calibration on SPY and QQQ options (2019–2024) finds stretched exponential tail decay consistent with rough volatility asymptotics, whereas classical MOT yields trivial bounds; the authors validate on live SPX/NDX data and scale to 30 assets using block-sparse optimization.
cards.originalTitle: Rough Martingale Optimal Transport: Theory, Implementation, and Regulatory Applications for Non-Modelable Risk Factors
cards.limitations: 所有理论结论与实证结果均来自作者自述，复现须依赖同一数据与求解器设置，尚未经独立验证。可辨识性定理的±0.05与50行权价、相关性局部识别均建立在模型假设与稀疏性设定之上，实际市场偏离假设时结论可能失效。资本缓释约8800万美元/10亿美元及100种子交叉验证的保守覆盖仅针对特定样本区间与账簿结构，不构成监管认可或投资建议。粗糙波动率先验本身带有模型风险，若先验设定错误，边界可能低估真实风险。30资产扩展依赖块稀疏优化，其数值稳定性与大规模外推能力有待检验。

cards.title: 两年学一项AI难替代技能：量化会议三种观点
cards.titleEn: Two Years, One AI-Resistant Skill: Three Perspectives from an Algo Trading Conference
cards.summary: 该内容来自QuantInsti第16届年度算法交易会议的小组讨论。三位嘉宾分别提出应学习实体构建与叙事、纯硬科学判断力或数据素养。这些回答属于个人观点，并非会议共识或研究结论。
cards.descriptionEn: At QuantInsti's 16th Annual Algo Trading Conference, a panel titled 'How AI is shaping careers in financial markets' featured three speakers offering different views on the one AI-resistant skill worth learning in two years, providing diverse perspectives for quant career planning.
cards.description: 在QuantInsti第16届算法交易会议“AI如何塑造金融市场职业”小组讨论中，三位嘉宾对两年内应学习的AI难替代技能给出不同答案，为量化职业规划提供了多样化视角。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Quant practitioners worry about AI replacing skills like coding; these views offer references for investing in career capabilities, emphasizing judgment, real-world building, and data discernment that are less replaceable by AI.
cards.whyItMatters: 量化从业者面临AI对编程等技能替代的担忧，这些观点提供了职业能力投资方向的参考，强调判断力、现实构建与数据辨别力等不易被AI替代的能力。
keyPoints: Ajay Sharma认为应学习在现实世界中构建东西以及讲故事。
Mridul Arora（Elevation Capital）主张学习纯硬科学，认为AI会写代码，但判断力来自对科学的理解。
Tony Lee（Alpaca）强调数据素养，以便区分信号与噪声。
cards.limitationsEn: The content consists of three panelists' personal opinions based on their experience and positions, without empirical data, quantitative analysis, or reproducible research results. The sample is small, conclusions are not universally applicable, and it should not be used as a basis for career returns or investment advice.
cards.summaryEn: The content comes from a panel discussion at QuantInsti's 16th Annual Algo Trading Conference. Three panelists respectively suggested learning real-world building and storytelling, pure hard sciences for judgment, or data literacy. These are personal opinions, not a consensus or research conclusion.
keyPointsEn: Ajay Sharma suggests learning to build things in the real world and to tell stories.
Mridul Arora (Elevation Capital) advocates pure hard sciences, arguing AI will write code but judgment comes from knowing the science.
Tony Lee (Alpaca) emphasizes data literacy to tell signal from noise.
cards.originalTitle: 2 years, 1 skill AI can't replace | Algo Trading Conference 2026
cards.limitations: 内容为三位嘉宾的个人观点，基于其经验与立场，未提供实证数据、定量分析或可复现的研究结果。样本量小，结论不具普适性，不能作为职业回报或投资建议的依据。

cards.title: TextualRL：用文本强化学习管理上下文，提升智能体表现
cards.titleEn: TextualRL: Textual Reinforcement Learning for Context Management to Improve Agent Performance
cards.summary: 论文指出，LLM 智能体可以通过修订文本上下文来适应任务反馈，而无需改动模型参数；但将执行奖励转化为可复用上下文更新存在困难。TextualRL 作为无梯度框架，把同一任务同一上下文下的一组 rollout 作为策略批评单元，通过组内政策批评与跨组政策更新生成有界文本补丁，并由留出验证奖励决定是否采纳。论文在五个目标智能体与六个基准上评估，称平均测试准确率较基础模型提升，但这是作者报告的结果，仍需独立复现。
cards.descriptionEn: TextualRL introduces a gradient-free reinforcement learning framework that treats multiple rollouts from the same task under the same context as the unit of policy critique, generates bounded textual patches through groupwise and cross-group review, and decides adoption via held-out validation rewards. It offers a new way to turn execution rewards into reusable context updates without fine-tuning model parameters, potentially improving LLM agents.
cards.description: TextualRL 提出一种无梯度强化学习框架，以同一任务下的多次 rollout 为策略批评单元，通过组内与跨组审查生成有界文本补丁，并依据验证奖励决定是否采纳。它为将执行奖励转化为可复用上下文更新提供了新方法，有助于无需微调模型即可改进 LLM 智能体。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This approach explores a path to absorb execution rewards by updating textual context alone, without changing model parameters, potentially offering a reusable mechanism for continual improvement of LLM agents. If robust, it could reduce reliance on parameter fine-tuning.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法探索了不改变模型参数、仅通过更新文本上下文来吸收执行奖励的路径，可能为 LLM 智能体的持续改进提供一种可复用机制；若结果稳健，可降低对参数微调的依赖。
keyPoints: TextualRL 以同任务同上下文下的一组 rollout 而非单条轨迹作为策略批评单元，对比成功与失败以提取修订信号。
组内结果一致时，方法会利用跨任务证据识别值得保留的行为或提出修复假设，再经跨组证据池审查。
审查后的提案形成有界文本补丁，候选上下文的采纳由留出验证奖励决定，构成奖励驱动的策略优化循环。
cards.limitationsEn: The input provides only abstract-level information, with no experimental details, benchmark names, statistical significance, ablation results, or failure cases. The evaluation relies on author-reported results and requires independent replication. Whether cross-task evidence causes overgeneralization, whether validation rewards are reliable, and how well it transfers across different models and tasks all need further verification.
cards.summaryEn: The paper states that LLM agents can adapt to task feedback by revising their textual context without changing model parameters, but turning execution rewards into reusable context updates is challenging. TextualRL is a gradient-free framework that uses a group of rollouts from the same task under the same context as the unit of policy critique; it combines Groupwise Policy Critique and Cross-Group Policy Update to form a bounded textual patch, with adoption determined by held-out validation rewards. The authors evaluate TextualRL with five target agents on six benchmarks and report average test accuracy improvements over the base model, but these are author-reported results that require independent replication.
keyPointsEn: TextualRL uses a group of rollouts from the same task under the same context, rather than an isolated trajectory, as the unit of policy critique, contrasting successful and failed rollouts to extract revision signals.
When outcomes are uniform, it draws on cross-task evidence to identify behaviors worth preserving or to formulate repair hypotheses, which are then reviewed against evidence pooled across groups.
Reviewed proposals form a bounded textual patch, and adoption of the candidate context is determined by held-out validation rewards, establishing a reward-driven policy optimization loop.
cards.originalTitle: TextualRL: Textual Reinforcement Learning for Context Management
cards.limitations: 输入材料仅提供摘要信息，未给出实验细节、基准名称、统计显著性、消融结果或失败案例；评估依赖作者报告，尚需独立复现。跨任务证据是否会带来过泛化、验证奖励是否可靠、以及不同模型与任务上的迁移性，均需进一步验证。

cards.title: 可执行环境监督拓展智能体工具使用数据
cards.titleEn: Executable Environments Scale Agentic Tool-Use Supervision
cards.summary: 论文指出可靠工具使用需要多样多步流程与可执行证据配对，仅扩大轨迹或仅强化验证都不够，因为新环境会引入必须反映在成功标准中的状态、规则与依赖。作者构建了 Davinci-ToolData，用 Execution-Grounded Task Synthesis 和 Executable Environment Synthesis 两条流水线生成可恢复状态、执行轨迹、结果与验证器，并据此先做监督微调，再用状态与验证器构造结果偏好做直接偏好优化。可核验事实是：数据含 30,395 条已验证轨迹、覆盖 2,260 个被调用工具名，模型为 30B，在 τ²-bench 从 52.4 提升至 88.2，BFCL v4 多轮从 30.4 提升至 62.8，MCP-Atlas 从 16.9 提升至 56.2；作者观点认为该路线以更少参数取得优于更大模型的基准表现，并公开代码。
cards.descriptionEn: The work introduces a dataset and model that scale environment coverage and outcome verification together, unifying restorable states, execution traces, outcomes, and verifiers as supervision substrate, and reusing states and verifiers to build preference data. It is directly relevant to researchers and engineering teams training reliable multi-step tool-use agents.
cards.description: 该工作提出将环境覆盖与结果验证同步扩展的数据集与模型，新在把可恢复状态、执行轨迹、结果和验证器统一为监督载体，并复用状态与验证器构造偏好数据。对需要可靠多步工具调用训练的研究者与工程团队有直接参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If executable verifier design remains effective as environments scale, this supervision approach may reduce reliance on manually labeled trajectories and offer a more auditable training path for multi-step tool-use agents.
cards.whyItMatters: 如果可执行验证器的设计能随环境扩展而保持有效，这种监督方式可能降低对人工标注轨迹的依赖，并为多步工具调用智能体提供更可审计的训练路径。
keyPoints: 论文提出 Davinci-ToolData，将可恢复状态、执行轨迹、结果和验证器统一为监督载体。
数据由 Execution-Grounded Task Synthesis 与 Executable Environment Synthesis 两条流水线生成，含 30,395 条已验证轨迹、覆盖 2,260 个工具名。
训练先做监督微调，再复用 EES 的状态与验证器比较备选动作并构造结果偏好做 DPO。
cards.limitationsEn: The paper does not report the distribution of the 30,395 trajectories across 2,260 tool names or across single and coordinated domains, nor does it give benchmark transparency and verifier coverage quality, data contamination risk, failure modes, or generalization to unseen tools; therefore benchmark gains cannot be interpreted as general improvement in tool-use ability or as a basis for investment conclusions.
cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that reliable tool use requires pairing diverse multi-step workflows with executable evidence, and that scaling trajectories or verification alone is insufficient because new environments introduce states, rules, and dependencies that must be reflected in success criteria. The authors build Davinci-ToolData with two pipelines, Execution-Grounded Task Synthesis and Executable Environment Synthesis, yielding restorable states, execution traces, outcomes, and verifiers, then use supervised fine-tuning followed by outcome-grounded preference construction for direct preference optimization. Verifiable facts: the data contains 30,395 verified trajectories spanning 2,260 invoked tool names, the model has 30B parameters, and reported gains are from 52.4 to 88.2 on τ²-bench, 30.4 to 62.8 on BFCL v4 multi-turn, and 16.9 to 56.2 on MCP-Atlas; the authors argue this route outperforms a larger model with far fewer parameters and release code.
keyPointsEn: Davinci-ToolData unifies restorable states, execution traces, outcomes, and verifiers as a supervision substrate.
Two pipelines, Execution-Grounded Task Synthesis and Executable Environment Synthesis, yield 30,395 verified trajectories spanning 2,260 tool names.
Training first uses supervised fine-tuning, then reuses EES states and verifiers to compare alternative actions and construct outcome-grounded preferences for DPO.
cards.originalTitle: Davinci-Tool: Scaling Agentic Tool-Use Supervision with Verifiable Executable Environments
cards.limitations: 论文未说明 30,395 条轨迹在 2,260 个工具名及单域与协同域上的分布，也未给出基准任务的透明度与验证器覆盖质量、数据污染风险、失败模式或泛化到未见工具的表现；因此不能把基准提升解释为通用工具使用能力的普遍改善，也不能据此推导投资结论。

cards.title: 从经济解释到业绩提升：机器学习投资组合的归因传播框架
cards.titleEn: From Economic Explanation to Performance Improvement in Machine-Learning Portfolios
cards.summary: 作者提出一种局部一阶归因传播框架，把配置函数中的特征暴露映射到序贯组合业绩指标的局部敏感度，并将传播归因与直接针对组合目标定义的 Shapley 值相关联。作者还推导了夏普比率归因的统计推断，并设计归因指导的特征暴露干预，实现不重训练配置模型的后训练适应。作者报告称，在不同模型类别上此类干预带来净夏普比率的统计显著提升。上述提升属于作者的实证发现，框架的经济解释价值与干预效果仍需独立验证。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a local first-order attribution-propagation framework that maps allocation-function feature exposures to local sensitivities of portfolio performance metrics, extending model-level feature importance to economically meaningful portfolio outcomes and decisions. Its novelty lies in deriving statistical inference for Sharpe-ratio attributions and using attribution-guided feature-exposure interventions for post-training adaptation without retraining the alloca
cards.description: 该研究提出局部一阶归因传播框架，将配置函数的特征暴露映射到组合业绩指标的局部敏感度，从而把模型层面的特征重要性拓展为具有经济意义的组合结果与决策解释。其新颖处在于为夏普比率归因建立统计推断，并利用归因指导的特征暴露干预实现无需重训练的组合模型后训练适应。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This framework advances feature importance in machine-learning portfolios from the model level to economically meaningful portfolio performance and decisions, and supports post-training adaptation without retraining, helping quantitative research connect interpretability with out-of-sample performance improvements.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架把机器学习投资组合的特征重要性从模型层面推进到具有经济含义的组合业绩与决策层面，并支持不重训练的后训练适应，有助于在量化研究中连接可解释性与样本外表现改进。
keyPoints: 提出局部一阶归因传播框架，将配置函数的特征暴露映射到序贯组合业绩指标的局部敏感度，并与直接针对组合目标定义的 Shapley 值相关联。
为夏普比率归因建立统计推断，并设计归因指导的特征暴露干预，使组合业绩解释可转化为样本外决策而无需重训练配置模型。
引入时间稳定化与跨模型平均作为补充正则化机制，并在不同模型类别上报告净夏普比率的统计显著提升。
cards.limitationsEn: The reported net Sharpe-ratio improvements are based on the authors' own empirical settings, and generalizability across markets, periods, and asset classes has not been verified. Attribution propagation relies on assumptions such as local first-order approximation and differentiability of the allocation function. Statistical significance does not equal economic significance, and full robustness checks involving transaction costs, capacity constraints, and implementation details are not covered.
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a local first-order attribution-propagation framework that maps feature exposures in the allocation function to local sensitivities of sequential portfolio performance metrics, relating the propagated attributions to Shapley values defined directly for portfolio objectives. They also derive statistical inference for Sharpe-ratio attributions and design attribution-guided feature-exposure interventions that enable post-training adaptation without retraining the underlying allocation model. The authors report that such interventions yield statistically significant improvements in net Sharpe ratios across different model classes. These improvements are the authors' empirical findings, and the framework's economic explanatory value and intervention effects still require independent verification.
keyPointsEn: A local first-order attribution-propagation framework is proposed to map allocation-function feature exposures to local sensitivities of sequential portfolio performance metrics and relate them to Shapley values defined directly for portfolio objectives.

Statistical inference for Sharpe-ratio attributions is derived, and attribution-guided feature-exposure interventions are designed to translate portfolio-metric explanations into out-of-sample decisions without retraining the allocation model.

Temporal stabilisation and cross-model averaging are introduced as complementary regularisation mechanisms, and statistically significant improvements in net Sharpe ratios are reported across different model classes.
cards.originalTitle: From Economic Explanation to Performance Improvement in Machine-Learning Portfolios
cards.limitations: 所报告的净夏普比率提升基于作者自身的实证设置，跨市场、跨时期与跨资产类别的泛化能力尚未验证；归因传播依赖局部一阶近似与配置函数可微性等假设；统计显著性不等同于经济显著性，且未涉及交易成本、容量约束与实施细节的完整稳健性检验。

cards.title: 神经估计限价订单簿路径的不可逆性
cards.titleEn: Neural Estimation of Irreversibility in Real and Simulated Limit Order Book Paths
cards.summary: 研究定义粗粒化限价订单簿路径的不可逆率为每事件前向与反向对数密度比，用顺序不变MLP和时序卷积网络从纳斯达克逐单数据中估计。对NVDA，顺序敏感估计0.054 nats/事件，顺序不变估计0.036，顺序增量为0.018；所有12个标的的日间样本增量均为正。校准的队列反应模拟器匹配市场有序率0.052与0.054，但顺序增量仅0.0006，远低于市场的0.018。
cards.descriptionEn: This study extends time irreversibility measurement from scalar series to limit order book paths, defines an irreversibility rate for coarse-grained paths, and compares order-invariant and order-sensitive neural network estimates, finding a significant positive ordering increment on Nasdaq market-by-order data that a queue-reactive simulator fails to reproduce.
cards.description: 该研究将时间不可逆性度量从标量序列推广到限价订单簿路径，定义了粗粒化路径的不可逆率，并比较了顺序不变与顺序敏感神经网络估计，在纳斯达克逐单数据上发现顺序增量显著为正，而队列反应模拟器无法复现该增量。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work proposes a new benchmark for order book simulators: beyond matching the overall irreversibility rate, they should reproduce the ordering increment and scale profile. This helps assess whether simulators capture directional mechanisms in real market paths rather than merely fitting statistical moments.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为订单簿模拟器提供了新的基准：除了匹配整体不可逆率，还应复现顺序增量和尺度剖面。这有助于评估模拟器是否捕捉到真实市场路径中的方向性机制，而非仅拟合统计矩。
keyPoints: 顺序敏感与顺序不变网络对NVDA的不可逆率估计分别为0.054和0.036 nats/事件，顺序增量0.018，且在所有12个标的的日间样本中均为正。
保持粗粒化一步转移表的替代数据恢复的不可逆性比观测路径低30%，表明路径顺序贡献了额外不可逆性。
队列反应模拟器匹配市场的整体有序率（0.052对0.054），但顺序增量仅0.0006，说明其时间不对称源于块组成而非块顺序。
cards.limitationsEn: The study uses only three weeks of Nasdaq market-by-order data, a short sample period; results depend on specific coarse-graining scales and network architectures; the queue-reactive simulator is compared under a single calibration setting; robustness across markets, time periods, or extreme conditions is not discussed.
cards.summaryEn: The study defines the irreversibility rate of a coarse-grained limit order book path as the forward-to-reverse log-density ratio per event, estimated from Nasdaq market-by-order data using an order-invariant MLP and a temporal convolutional network. For NVDA, the order-sensitive estimate is 0.054 nats per event versus 0.036 for the order-invariant, yielding an ordering increment of 0.018; the increment is positive for all 12 symbols on held-out daytime dates. A calibrated queue-reactive simulator matches the market's ordered rate (0.052 vs 0.054) but has an ordering increment of only 0.0006, far below the market's 0.018.
keyPointsEn: Order-sensitive and order-invariant networks estimate NVDA irreversibility at 0.054 and 0.036 nats per event, respectively, giving an ordering increment of 0.018 that is positive for all 12 symbols on held-out daytime dates.
Surrogates preserving the coarse one-step transition table recover 30% less irreversibility than observed paths, indicating that path order contributes additional irreversibility.

A queue-reactive simulator matches the market's overall ordered rate (0.052 vs 0.054) but has an ordering increment of only 0.0006, meaning its temporal asymmetry arises from block composition rather than block order.
cards.originalTitle: Neural Estimation of Irreversibility in Real and Simulated Limit Order Book Paths
cards.limitations: 研究仅使用三周纳斯达克逐单数据，样本期较短；结果基于特定粗粒化尺度和网络架构；队列反应模拟器仅在一个校准设置下比较；未讨论跨市场、跨时期或极端行情下的稳健性。

cards.title: 大语言模型人权对齐基准UDHRBench发布：效率与中立说辞成违规主因
cards.titleEn: UDHRBench: A Benchmark for LLM Human Rights Alignment Reveals Efficiency and Neutrality Rationales as Main Violation Drivers
cards.summary: 事实：研究发布了UDHRBench基准，包含1124道覆盖《世界人权宣言》30条条款的人权质询问题，以及ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini、Fanar四个模型共4496条回答，由专家人工标注对齐情况，标注者间一致性κ=0.801；分析发现模型违规通常通过诉诸效率、风险管理或科学中立等看似理性的推理出现，而非直接拒绝权利；研究还提出LLM-as-a-Judge评估框架，加权F1为89.8%，并引入Alignment Leniency Score。作者观点：模型与国际人权标准之间存在系统性的、非平凡的对齐偏差；自动评估框架可用于规模化检测人权对齐问题。
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces UDHRBench, a benchmark covering all 30 articles of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, with 1,124 human-rights-confronting questions and 4,496 responses from four large language models (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, Fanar). Expert annotations achieve high inter-annotator agreement (κ=0.801). Its novelty lies in operationalizing human rights compliance evaluation into a reproducible dataset and showing that violations typically arise from seemingly ration
cards.description: 该研究构建了覆盖《世界人权宣言》全部30条条款的1124道人权质询问题，并收集四个大语言模型共4496条回答，由专家人工标注对齐情况（标注者间一致性κ=0.801）。新意在于首次将人权合规评估操作化为可复现的基准数据集，并揭示模型违规多源于诉诸效率、风险管理或科学中立等看似理性的推理，而非直接否定权利。同时提出基于零样本与少样本提示的LLM-as-a-Judge自动评估框架，加权F1达89.8%，以及量化法官模型在模糊案例中裁决倾向的Alignment Leniency Sc
cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark advances human rights compliance from principled discussion to a quantifiable, reproducible evaluation task, helping identify systematic misalignment patterns in ethical and legal contexts and providing a reference framework for automated auditing.
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准将人权合规从原则性讨论推进为可量化、可复现的评估任务，有助于识别模型在伦理与法律规范场景中的系统性错位模式，并为自动化审计提供可参考的框架。
keyPoints: UDHRBench覆盖《世界人权宣言》全部30条条款，含1124道人权质询问题与四个大语言模型共4496条回答，专家标注一致性κ=0.801。
模型违规多通过效率、风险管理或科学中立等理性化说辞出现，而非明确拒绝人权。
LLM-as-a-Judge框架在零样本与少样本提示下检测人权错位达到89.8%加权F1，并引入Alignment Leniency Score量化法官模型在模糊案例中的裁决倾向。
cards.limitationsEn: The benchmark covers only four large language models (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, Fanar), so generalization to others requires caution; the data derive from specific prompts and response sets and may be influenced by question framing; expert annotations, though with high agreement, still involve subjective judgment; the 89.8% weighted F1 of the LLM-as-a-Judge indicates a non-zero error rate; the Alignment Leniency Score is a newly proposed metric whose robustness and cross-scenario applicability need independent validation; the dataset and code are planned for open-source release, but as of this publication the release process may still be ongoing.
cards.summaryEn: Facts: The study released UDHRBench, containing 1,124 human rights questions covering all 30 articles of the UDHR and 4,496 responses from four models (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, Fanar), with expert annotations (κ=0.801); analysis found violations typically occur through seemingly rational reasoning such as appeals to efficiency, risk management, or scientific neutrality, rather than explicit rejection of rights; it also proposed an LLM-as-a-Judge framework achieving 89.8% weighted F1 and introduced an Alignment Leniency Score. Authors' view: There are systematic and non-trivial misalignments between models and international human rights standards; the automated framework can help detect human rights alignment issues at scale.
keyPointsEn: UDHRBench covers all 30 articles of the UDHR, with 1,124 human rights questions and 4,496 responses from four LLMs, and expert annotation agreement of κ=0.801.
Violations often appear through rationalized appeals to efficiency, risk management, or scientific neutrality rather than explicit rejection of rights.

The LLM-as-a-Judge framework detects human rights misalignment with 89.8% weighted F1 under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, and an Alignment Leniency Score quantifies judge models' resolution of ambiguous cases.
cards.originalTitle: UDHRBench: Benchmarking Human Rights in Large Language Models
cards.limitations: 基准仅覆盖四个大语言模型（ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini、Fanar），结论外推至其他模型需谨慎；数据来源于特定提示与回答集，可能受提问方式影响；人工标注虽一致性较高但仍含主观判断；LLM-as-a-Judge的89.8%加权F1表明存在错误率；Alignment Leniency Score为研究提出的新指标，其稳健性与跨场景适用性有待独立验证；数据集与代码计划开源，但截至该发布时仍在开放过程中。

cards.title: 巴菲特效应：明星投资者披露新仓位带来的异常溢价
cards.titleEn: The Buffett Effect: Abnormal Premium from New-Position Disclosures by Recognizable Investors
cards.summary: 论文研究投资者知名度是否会使披露的新持仓产生超越可比但不知名经理的市场反应，并将其定义为“巴菲特效应”。作者将维基百科页面浏览量和ProQuest新闻提及合成知名度指数，在2000至2025年样本中比较24只知名基金与24只匹配对照基金，发现知名度越高，披露日及随后交易日的正向披露溢价越大。作者认为证据最符合“注意力—信息”纠缠渠道，即知名度引导稀缺注意力流向特定披露，披露中的信息随后被资本化进价格；跟单最知名投资者可获得持续数月不反转的显著alpha。
cards.descriptionEn: This paper builds a recognition index from Wikipedia pageviews and ProQuest news mentions, compares 24 highly recognizable funds with 24 matched control funds, and finds a positive disclosure premium when recognizable investors reveal new positions, with the premium rising in recognition. A calendar-time portfolio that mechanically copies the most recognized investors' disclosures earns significant alpha that persists for months without reversal. Its value lies in adding inve
cards.description: 这篇论文用维基百科浏览量与新闻提及量构建“知名度指数”，将24位高知名度基金经理与24位匹配的对照组经理进行对比，发现高知名度投资者披露新建仓时存在正向的披露溢价，且溢价随知名度上升；机械跟随其披露买入的日历时间组合能获得持续数月、不反转的显著alpha。其价值在于把投资者知名度这一常被忽略的维度引入事件研究与跟单策略分析，并给出可度量的识别方法。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study suggests that who discloses may matter as much as what is disclosed for price reactions, offering a quantifiable recognition dimension for event studies and copy-trading strategies. If the premium stems from attention misallocation rather than information alone, it has direct implications for market efficiency debates and for assessing trading costs and crowding. This summarizes research findings and is not investment advice.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提示上市公司信息披露中的“谁在披露”可能与“披露了什么”同样影响价格反应，为事件研究和跟单策略提供了一个可量化的知名度维度；同时，若溢价源于注意力错配而非单纯信息，则对市场有效性讨论和交易成本、拥挤度评估具有直接含义。注意以上为对研究发现的概括，不构成任何投资建议。
keyPoints: 以维基百科浏览量与新闻提及构建知名度指数，将24只知名基金与24只匹配基金对照，2000至2025年数据显示知名度越高披露溢价越大。
机械复制各类披露买入的日历时间组合中，复制最知名投资者的组合可获得持续数月且未反转的显著alpha。
作者将机制解释为注意力—信息纠缠渠道：知名度把稀缺投资者注意力导向特定披露，披露信息随后被计入价格。
cards.limitationsEn: The sample covers only 24 recognizable funds and 24 matched controls, so findings are constrained by the matching method and limited representativeness; the recognition index relies on Wikipedia and ProQuest, which may capture media or online prominence rather than actual investor awareness. The design is observational and cannot fully rule out omitted variables, contemporaneous news, and selection effects, and attention versus information channels are hard to separate cleanly. The copy-portfolio alpha reflects the authors' specific sample period and modeling assumptions, ignoring real trading costs, capacity limits, and crowding by competing capital; generalizability beyond the 2025 sample end is unknown.
cards.summaryEn: The paper asks whether investor recognition generates market reactions to new-position disclosures beyond those of comparable but unrecognized managers, defining this as the Buffett effect. Using a recognition index from Wikipedia pageviews and ProQuest news mentions over 2000–2025, the authors compare 24 recognizable discretionary funds with 24 matched controls and find a positive disclosure premium around the filing date and subsequent trading days that increases with recognition. The evidence is said to be most consistent with an entangled attention-information channel, in which recognition directs scarce attention to selected disclosures whose information is then capitalized into prices; copying the most recognized investors yields significant alpha that persists for months and does not reverse.
keyPointsEn: A recognition index built from Wikipedia pageviews and news mentions, applied to 24 recognizable funds versus 24 matched controls over 2000–2025, shows a larger disclosure premium as recognition rises.
Calendar-time portfolios that mechanically copy disclosed purchases earn significant alpha when copying the most recognized investors, persisting for months without reversal.

The authors interpret the mechanism as an entangled attention-information channel: recognition channels scarce investor attention toward selected disclosures, and the disclosed information is then priced in.
cards.limitations: 样本仅覆盖24只知名基金与24只匹配对照基金，结论受匹配方法与小样本代表性限制；知名度指数基于维基百科与ProQuest，可能反映媒体与网络热度而非投资者真实认知。研究为观察性设计，无法完全排除遗漏变量、同期消息与选择效应，注意力和信息渠道难以干净分离；跟单组合的alpha为作者在特定样本期与建模假设下的结果，未考虑实际交易成本、容量限制与竞争性资金涌入，且样本期截至2025年，未来外推性未知。

cards.title: VoiceStudio：全本地开源语音克隆与多语言配音工具
cards.titleEn: VoiceStudio: A Fully Local Open-Source Voice Cloning and Multilingual Dubbing Tool
cards.summary: VoiceStudio 是一个开源、全本地运行的语音工具，目标是替代 ElevenLabs 等云端语音服务。项目方声称覆盖声音克隆、声音设计、视频配音、听写、转录及有声书制作，并支持 646 种语言。上述功能与语言数量来自项目自述，尚未在本次输入中提供独立验证或性能评测。
cards.descriptionEn: VoiceStudio is a GitHub trending project positioned as a fully local, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs, bundling voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation, with a claimed 646-language scope. Its novelty lies in packaging speech capabilities that often rely on cloud APIs into a local tool, which is relevant to developers and creators focused on privacy and offline use.
cards.description: VoiceStudio 是 GitHub 趋势项目，定位为全本地运行的 ElevenLabs 开源替代方案，集成声音克隆、声音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，宣称支持 646 种语言。它的新意在于将此前多依赖云端 API 的语音能力打包为本地工具，对注重隐私和离线使用的开发者与创作者有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Voice cloning and transcription have long relied on cloud APIs, raising concerns about data transfer, cost, and network dependency. If VoiceStudio truly runs fully locally as claimed, it could offer an open-source option for privacy-sensitive, offline, or cost-constrained scenarios. However, practical usability, voice quality, language coverage accuracy, and hardware requirements still need independent verification.
cards.whyItMatters: 语音克隆和转录长期依赖云端 API，涉及数据外传、费用和网络依赖。VoiceStudio 若如自述般实现全本地运行，可为隐私敏感、离线或成本受限的场景提供开源选择。但实际可用性、语音质量、语言覆盖准确度和硬件门槛仍需独立验证。
keyPoints: 项目定位为开源、完全本地运行的 ElevenLabs 替代方案，核心场景包括声音克隆、声音设计与视频配音。
项目自述还包括听写、转录和有声书制作，并宣称支持 646 种语言。
作为 GitHub 趋势项目，其价值主张是让语音生成与处理在本地完成，减少对云端服务的依赖。
cards.limitationsEn: This card is based solely on the project's self-description on its GitHub trending page; no authors, papers, benchmarks, or independent reproduction results are provided. The 646-language support, voice cloning quality, local runtime performance, and resource requirements are unverified in this input. The project may be at an early stage, and feature completeness and long-term maintenance are unknown. This is not investment or procurement advice.
cards.summaryEn: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully local voice toolkit intended to replace cloud services such as ElevenLabs. The project claims to cover voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. These features and language counts come from the project's self-description and were not independently verified or benchmarked in the provided input.
keyPointsEn: The project is positioned as an open-source, fully local alternative to ElevenLabs, with core scenarios including voice cloning, voice design, and video dubbing.
The project also claims dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation, plus support for 646 languages.
As a GitHub trending project, its value proposition is to perform speech generation and processing locally, reducing dependence on cloud services.
cards.limitations: 本卡仅依据 GitHub 趋势页的项目自述，未包含作者、论文、基准测试或独立复现结果。646 种语言支持、声音克隆效果、本地运行性能与资源需求均未经本次输入验证。项目可能处于早期阶段，功能完整性和长期维护情况未知。不构成任何投资或采购建议。

cards.title: CLI-Anything 项目：让所有软件支持智能体调用
cards.titleEn: CLI-Anything Project: Making All Software Agent-Native
cards.summary: CLI-Anything 是香港大学数据科学实验室在 GitHub 上开源的项目，口号为“Making ALL Software Agent-Native”。项目同时维护一个名为 CLI-Hub 的网站（clianything.cc），可能是用于发现或管理命令行工具的 hub。目前公开信息仅为项目标题和链接，未提供技术细节或评估数据。
cards.descriptionEn: The project proposes a general approach to turn arbitrary command-line software into agent-native tools, with CLI-Hub as a companion discovery platform; it is of reference value to developers looking to expand the range of tools agents can operate.
cards.description: 该项目提出让任意命令行软件成为智能体原生工具的通用方案，并提供了 CLI-Hub 作为配套发现平台；对需要扩展智能体可操作工具范围的开发者有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If feasible, the approach could significantly lower the barrier for agents to invoke command-line tools and expand the coverage of automation tasks; CLI-Hub may also become an entry point for tool discovery and sharing, potentially impacting the AI agent ecosystem.
cards.whyItMatters: 若方案可行，将显著降低智能体调用命令行工具的门槛，扩展自动化任务的覆盖范围；CLI-Hub 也可能成为工具发现和共享的入口，对 AI 智能体生态有潜在影响。
keyPoints: 项目由 HKUDS 发布，目标是让所有软件都成为智能体原生工具。
项目附带 CLI-Hub 在线平台，网址为 clianything.cc。
当前仅有项目名称和简短口号，技术实现与效果未知。
cards.limitationsEn: Currently, only the GitHub project name, tagline, and CLI-Hub link are available. There are no public technical papers, code descriptions, performance evaluations, or use cases. It is impossible to judge its actual capabilities, generality, security, or the degree of adaptation to existing CLI tools. Therefore, all judgments are based on limited information and should not be regarded as verified conclusions.
cards.summaryEn: CLI-Anything is an open-source project by HKUDS on GitHub with the tagline 'Making ALL Software Agent-Native'. It also maintains a website called CLI-Hub (clianything.cc), possibly for discovering or managing command-line tools. Currently, public information is limited to the project title and link, without technical details or evaluation data.
keyPointsEn: The project is released by HKUDS with the goal of making all software agent-native.
It comes with an online platform called CLI-Hub at clianything.cc.
Only the project name and a brief tagline are available; technical implementation and effectiveness are unknown.
cards.limitations: 目前仅有 GitHub 项目名、口号和 CLI-Hub 链接，没有公开的技术论文、代码说明、性能评估或使用案例。无法判断其实际能力、通用性、安全性及对现有 CLI 工具的适配程度，因此所有判断均基于有限信息，不应视为已验证的结论。

cards.title: iFixAi：AI 智能体独立审计工具亮相
cards.titleEn: iFixAi: Independent Auditing Tool for AI Agents Launched
cards.summary: 该工具的目标是回答 AI 智能体经济中的关键问题：智能体是否在做它应该做的事。它支持由人工或智能体自身运行，并宣称能在 120 秒内返回结果。以上信息来自 GitHub Trending 的简要描述。
cards.descriptionEn: Addresses whether AI agents do what they are supposed to do, offering independent auditing run by a human or the agent itself, with a claimed answer in under 120 seconds.
cards.description: 针对 AI 智能体是否按预期行事这一核心问题，提供独立审计能力，宣称可在 120 秒内给出答案，由人工或智能体自身运行。
cards.whyItMattersEn: As agents gain autonomy, directly judging whether their behavior meets expectations becomes difficult; independent auditing can improve trust and controllability of agent execution.
cards.whyItMatters: 智能体自主性增强后，其行为是否符合预期难以直接判断，独立审计有助于提升对智能体执行的信任与可控性。
keyPoints: 定位为 AI 智能体的独立审计，旨在验证智能体行为是否符合预期。
运行方式灵活，可由人工或智能体自身发起。
宣称在 120 秒内完成审计并给出答案。
cards.limitationsEn: Only a short GitHub Trending summary is available; no technical details, validation methods, accuracy metrics, or independent evaluations are provided, nor are author and documentation information. The 120-second claim lacks test conditions, and actual performance should be based on official documentation or reproducible experiments.
cards.summaryEn: The tool aims to answer the key question in the AI agent economy: whether an agent is doing what it is supposed to do. It can be run by a human or the agent itself, and claims to return a result in under 120 seconds. This information comes from a brief GitHub Trending description.
keyPointsEn: Positioned as independent auditing of AI agents to verify whether agent behavior matches expectations.
Flexible execution: can be initiated by a human or by the agent itself.
Claims to complete the audit and provide an answer within 120 seconds.
cards.limitations: 目前仅有 GitHub Trending 的简短摘要，未提供技术细节、验证方法、准确率或独立评测，也无作者与文档信息；120 秒的宣称未给出测试条件，实际效果需以官方文档或可复现实验为准。

cards.title: 用投机解码为本地推理加速：直播活动介绍
cards.titleEn: Accelerating Local Inference with Speculative Decoding: Livestream Overview
cards.summary: 直播围绕投机解码技术展开，旨在利用草稿模型提升本地大模型推理速度。议程包括 Hugging Face 的 Merve Noyan 介绍投机解码基础，RedHat 的 Eldar Kurtić 讲解 speculators 库入门，以及 Google DeepMind 的 Maarten Grootendorst 演示使用 MTP 草稿模型加速 Gemma-4。具体加速效果、代码细节与实验数据需以直播内容为准，本卡未做额外验证。
cards.descriptionEn: This Hugging Face livestream focuses on speculative decoding, a technique that uses draft models to accelerate large-model inference. It covers methods like EAGLE, DFlash, and MTP, and demonstrates their application with llama.cpp, transformers, and the speculators library, offering practical insights for developers interested in local AI deployment efficiency.
cards.description: 该直播由 Hugging Face 组织，聚焦投机解码这一通过草稿模型加速大模型推理的技术，介绍 EAGLE、DFlash、MTP 等方案，并展示如何在 llama.cpp、transformers 及 speculators 库中应用，适合关注本地 AI 部署效率的开发者获取实操信息。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Speculative decoding is an important technique for speeding up local large language model inference. This livestream provides a systematic introduction from principles to tool usage, covering the speculators library and a concrete model acceleration case, offering reference value for developers seeking to reduce inference latency in local environments.
cards.whyItMatters: 投机解码是提升本地大语言模型推理速度的重要技术方向，该直播提供了从原理到工具使用的系统性介绍，并涵盖 speculators 库与具体模型加速案例，对希望在本地环境降低推理延迟的开发者具有参考价值。
keyPoints: 直播主题为投机解码（Speculative Decoding），涉及 EAGLE、DFlash、MTP 等方法。
议程包含三个环节：投机解码基础、speculators 库上手、用 MTP 草稿模型加速 Gemma-4。
涉及工具链包括 llama.cpp、transformers 和 speculators 库。
cards.limitationsEn: This information is based solely on a livestream announcement; no specific speedup ratios, benchmark data, compatibility scope, or experimental conditions are provided. The described acceleration effects may depend on specific hardware, models, and configurations, and actual performance should be verified via the livestream or subsequent code. This card does not constitute any technical selection or investment advice.
cards.summaryEn: The livestream centers on speculative decoding, aiming to speed up local large-model inference using draft models. The agenda includes an introduction to speculative decoding by Merve Noyan (Hugging Face), a getting-started session on the speculators library by Eldar Kurtić (RedHat), and a demonstration of accelerating Gemma-4 with MTP drafters by Maarten Grootendorst (Google DeepMind). Specific speedups, code details, and experimental data are subject to the livestream content and not independently verified here.
keyPointsEn: The livestream focuses on speculative decoding, covering methods such as EAGLE, DFlash, and MTP.
The agenda includes three sessions: speculative decoding fundamentals, getting started with the speculators library, and accelerating Gemma-4 with MTP drafters.
The toolchain involved includes llama.cpp, transformers, and the speculators library.
cards.originalTitle: Local AI 202: Get Massive Speed-ups with Speculative Decoding
cards.limitations: 该信息仅来自直播预告，未提供具体加速比、基准测试数据、兼容性范围或实验条件。所述加速效果可能依赖于特定硬件、模型和配置，实际表现需以直播演示或后续代码验证为准。本卡不构成任何技术选型或投资建议。
